title: Kestrel and the Terminal Again
author: Mara Hartwell
blurb: Marguerite Winterbourne, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
